name: Glacial erratic perched on smaller stones 039
variety: glacial erratic perched on smaller stones
modifier: standing in a patch of wildflowers
prompt: a single natural fieldstone boulder resting on the ground, rounded and weathered, with subtle cracks, pits and patches of moss, glacial erratic perched on smaller stones, standing in a patch of wildflowers, waist-high, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

LIT_1.glow_concept: molten orange soulstone veins in deep cracks

motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. ONLY the outermost edge of the orange cracks across the rock changes: a few pixels along that edge shift very slightly in brightness and shift straight back. The orange cracks across the rock is fully visible and exactly as easy to read in every single frame, including the last -- it never fades, never dims, never vanishes and is never swallowed by glare. Its inside stays exactly the orange it is in the first frame and never turns pale or white. Nothing is added or removed anywhere, and nothing changes size. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour. The last frame matches the first exactly.

light.reference: the spawn bonfire is 1.0 (radius 7); strength 0 is no light
